governance_invariants.prohibit_delta_alone: Delta_R_sec > 0 ALONE is insufficient to establish Backfire without verified temporal and physical causal linkage.
governance_invariants.prohibit_post_hoc_attribution: Events occurring in POST window cannot be retroactively assigned to intervention without continuous causal tracing.

gate_objective: Verify that any observed secondary risk increase is strictly and demonstrably caused by the primary safety intervention, rather than independent facility dynamics or confounding traffic.

prerequisites.description: Secondary zone hazard state must be quantified during baseline window T0 (duration >= 4.0s).
Secondary zone hazard state must be quantified during post-intervention window T5 (duration >= 4.0s).

temporal_link_to_intervention.definition: The onset of secondary hazard must occur strictly within delta_t <= 2.0s following the primary intervention maneuver.

observable_causal_path.definition: A continuous physical path connecting the vehicle swerve, load deflection, or displaced worker into the secondary zone.

confounder_assessment.description: Indicates whether independent facility activity coincided with the event window.

NEW_ACTOR.description: A previously undetected worker enters the secondary zone from outside the camera frame.
NEW_ACTOR.impact: If entry occurred independently of vehicle avoidance, CAUSAL_ISOLATION = FAILED.

NEW_FORKLIFT.description: A secondary vehicle enters the scene during the post-window (e.g. UNION_CAND_Warehouse_027_003).
NEW_FORKLIFT.impact: Severely compromises causal attribution. Route to INSUFFICIENT_BACKFIRE_EVIDENCE.

TRACK_HANDOFF.description: Automated tracker switches track ID or conflates two distinct vehicles/persons.
TRACK_HANDOFF.impact: Invalidates trajectory continuity. Route to INSUFFICIENT_BACKFIRE_EVIDENCE.

INDEPENDENT_WORKER_CLUSTER.description: Shift-change routine or group transit across adjacent corridor (e.g. UNION_CAND_Warehouse_027_001).
INDEPENDENT_WORKER_CLUSTER.impact: Competitively explains secondary pedestrian density. CAUSAL_ISOLATION = FAILED.

UNRELATED_TRAFFIC.description: High-density multi-forklift operations (e.g. UNION_CAND_Warehouse_026_014 with 5 active forklifts).
UNRELATED_TRAFFIC.impact: Cross-cutting traffic prevents single-cause attribution. CAUSAL_ISOLATION = FAILED.

causal_isolation_rule.action: Set CAUSAL_ISOLATION_STATUS = FAILED and force candidate_class = INSUFFICIENT_BACKFIRE_EVIDENCE.

stages.name: INTERVENTION
stages.description: Safety deceleration or avoidance maneuver executed.

stages.name: PRIMARY_MITIGATION
stages.description: Collision in primary zone successfully averted.

stages.name: RISK_REDIRECTION
stages.description: Kinetic energy or worker displacement directed toward secondary zone.

temporal_precedence_invariants.strict_ordering_rule: T0 < T1 < T2 <= T3 <= T4 < T5. Any violation invalidates Backfire candidacy.
